stem.flightsim.coaching_challenge_comple: Ibyagaragaye byerekanye ko intego z’igerageza zagezweho. Ubu, mu mwitozo wo gucunga ingufu, gereranya kumanuka moteri ikora ku muvuduko muto no kuzamuka ukoresheje imbaraga za moteri.
stem.flightsim.coaching_energy_complete: Ibyagaragaye byerekanye ko intego zo gucunga ingufu zagezweho. Ubu itoze kugenzura ingufu mu rugendo rugufi rwo kwegera ikibuga cy’indege, hanyuma ugereranye umuvuduko wo kumanuka no gukora ku butaka.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_low: Batiri iri hafi gushira: hasigaye {pct}%. Subira aho wahagurukiye maze ugwe ku butaka vuba.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_depleted_bo: Igihe umuriro wa batiri wageze kuri 0%, urugendo rw’indege rwahagaritswe by’agateganyo. Soza ubutumwa kugira ngo usuzume iri gerageza, hanyuma utangire ubutumwa bushya ufite batiri yuzuye.
stem.flightsim.geoq_nearest_place: Ni hehe hegereye cyane aho uri ubu?
stem.flightsim.geoq_paused: Urugendo rw’indege rwahagaritswe by’agateganyo kubera iki kibazo. Funga ibibazo, hanyuma uhitemo Gukomeza igihe witeguye kuguruka.
stem.flightsim.geoq_unavailable: Nta kibazo cy’ubumenyi bw’isi gihari ku hantu hafi yawe. Komeza gushakisha maze wongere ugerageze.
